inputDoc: State-driven bot (scripts/export-fixtures.ts makeWalker, adapted from enemies.determinism.test.ts): walks the BFS path toward the boss room, fights engaged enemies within 7 units (random strafes, FIRE 75 %, ROLL 12 %, SWAP 3 %, aimed at the nearest live actor), flask at <= 2 half hearts, Ember at <= 1. No god mode: the player can die (see final / firstTick). The recording is authoritative.
